There is a quiet little pleasure at being understood, not a standard polite smile. She is not vacant, sleepy, timidly obedient, crying, or a generic gentle adult woman. Express a thoughtful young person with her own attention and one particular feeling.

No glossy/plastic 3D, photoreal skin pores, mature lips/heavy makeup/eyelashes, adult sharp jaw, glamour photo, stiff standing-doll expression, generic service smile, painted backdrop, glow halo, vignette, floor shadow or checkerboard. Independent full transparent portrait with no borrowed scene pixels.
